resolution: Fixed Face to N-gon rotation by phasing the generated regular loop from the selected source face's first directed edge instead of its first corner. The first generated N-gon edge now remains parallel to the source edge for every target side count, eliminating the visible re-rotation between 5 and 17 sides. Added a focused Zig regression for both counts; 187 mesh-edit tests and the ReleaseFast editor build pass.
